text:
rachel: FYI saw duplicate customer rows after our async client retried a timed-out POST. Not the same as earlier idempotency fixesthis one looks like replay overlap across hosts.

tom: can you share the client config and the header set? which transport (httpx/aiohttp)?

rachel: httpx AsyncClient, default timeout 1.5s, our RetryMiddleware enabled (max_retries=3, base_backoff=0.1, jitter=0.05). We include X-Idempotency-Key but server still created two resources. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-20T14:01:12Z] -> POST /v1/customers id=req-9f
[2026-03-20T14:01:13Z] client timeout id=req-9f elapsed=1.5s
[2026-03-20T14:01:13Z] retry attempt=2 id=req-9f
[2026-03-20T14:01:13Z] -> POST /v1/customers id=req-9f
[2026-03-20T14:01:14Z] 201 Created id=cid_821
[2026-03-20T14:01:15Z] 201 Created id=cid_822
```
looks like two different backend replicas accepted the request.

arjun: sounds like our backoff produces almost identical schedules so the second attempt reached a different replica before the first completed in the cluster.

nina: double-check the payload checksum header we send. Some services dedupe on (idempotency-key, body-hash). We only set X-Idempotency-Key.
rachel: good point. We don't compute body checksums by default because of perf. But adding an optional X-Body-Hash could help server-side dedupe.

tom: two prongs of mitigation: 1) improve backoff to avoid synchronized retries (recommend adopting exponential full-jitter or "decorrelated jitter"), 2) make post-timeout behavior conservative for POSTs unless explicit idempotency metadata present.

arjun: agreed. Also, on timeout we should try to aggressively cancel the underlying httpx stream/sockets so the in-flight attempt doesn't linger. I filed a small helper to cancel and drain: `await req.acancel()` (pseudocode).

rachel: prototype patch attached in PR: https://git.internal/redwood/py-sdk/pulls/802 with changes:
- switch RetryMiddleware to exponential full-jitter backoff
- add optional `body_hash` generation and header X-Body-Hash when `enable_body_hash=True`
- add `replay_on_timeout` default False for non-idempotent methods unless X-Idempotency-Key present
- stronger cancellation on timeout for httpx transport

code excerpt:
```
# simplified backoff
sleep = base * (2 ** attempt)
sleep = random.uniform(0, sleep)
await asyncio.sleep(min(sleep, cap))
```
and payload hash sample: `sha256(json.dumps(body, separators=(",":"), sort_keys=True)).hexdigest()`

tom: can you add a small integration test that simulates delayed success after client timeout? We should assert server stub received one POST and returned single resource id. Make it robust with timeouts instead of sleeps to avoid flakiness.

arjun: note on semantics: we should only allow automatic replay on timeouts if X-Idempotency-Key present and `replay_on_timeout=True`. For 5xx responses it's fine to retry for idempotent methods. This mirrors what we decided last quarter but not implemented everywhere.

nina: +1. Also add a clear line in the SDK docs: "POSTs may be retried only when X-Idempotency-Key is set or when user opts-in via replay_on_timeout". Example snippet: 
```
client = AsyncClient(timeout=3.0, replay_on_timeout=False, enable_body_hash=True)
await client.post('/v1/customers', json=payload, headers={'X-Idempotency-Key': kid})
```

rachel: updated changelog entry in the PR and a small troubleshooting section. CI currently flaky because the timing test occasionally races.

ci-bot: build #4682  unstable tests: test_retry_race -> rerun queued.

tom: For flakiness, make the test deterministic by mocking the server response timing rather than sleeping. httpx MockTransport can simulate a late response after the client's timeout to reproduce the exact window.

arjun: also we should coordinate with backend teams: if they can make dedupe rely strictly on X-Idempotency-Key and body hash, that reduces cross-node races. I'll ping infra-api.

nina: we should run a quick audit across client repos (node, go, ruby) to ensure consistent default: conservative for POSTs, require idempotency key to auto-replay on timeout. I can draft the audit checklist.

rachel: thanks. I'll update PR with mock-based tests, add docs, and roll out a canary. Assigning eng-sdk for review.

tom: great. labeling P2 and scheduling review. thanks for the catch rachel. :rocket:
